68304-the-catspaw.title: The Catspaw
68304-the-catspaw.creator: Unknown
68304-the-catspaw.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ped folds hanging low in a gorgeous pattern of silken folds. It was gently tinted in delicate colors that blended in a complete lack of regular pattern. It seemed more beautiful for lacking pattern than it could have been with any regularity.

arxiv-2010-08352.title: Focused Proof-search in the Logic of Bunched Implications Thanks: This work has been partially supported by the UK’s EPSRC through research grant EP/S013008/1. Affiliation: University College London, London, United Kingdom
arxiv-2010-08352.creator: Alexander Gheorghiu(🖂), Sonia Marin(🖂)
arxiv-2010-08352.description: Abstract The logic of Bunched Implications (BI) freely combines additive and multiplicative connectives, including implications; however, despite its well-studied proof theory, proof-search in BI has always been a difficult problem. The focusing principle is a restriction of the proof-search space that can capture various goal-directed proof-search procedures.

arxiv-2112-11601.title: Realizations of Measurement Based Quantum Computing
arxiv-2112-11601.creator: Swapnil Nitin Shah
arxiv-2112-11601.description: Abstract The Measurement Based Quantum Computation (MBQC) model achieves universal quantum computation by employing projective single qubit measurements with classical feedforward on a highly entangled multipartite cluster state Raussendorf and Briegel 2001 . Rapid advances in improving scalability of quantum computing systems have enabled the generation of large cluster states for implementing MBQC on various platforms.

arxiv-2203-05700.title: generalized tracially approximated C ∗ {\rm C^{*}} -algebras Thanks: Key words C ∗ {\rm C^{*}} -algebras, tracial approximation, Cuntz semigroup. Thanks: 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification : 46L35, 46L05, 46L80
arxiv-2203-05700.creator: George A. Elliott, Qingzhai Fan, and Xiaochun Fang
arxiv-2203-05700.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce some classes of generalized tracial approximation C ∗ {\rm C^{*}} -algebras. Consider the class of unital C ∗ {\rm C^{*}} -algebras which are tracially 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} -absorbing (or have tracial nuclear dimension at most n n , or have the property SP \rm SP , or are m m -almost divisible).

arxiv-2210-16285.title: A Multi-feature Dataset for Windows PE Malware Classification
arxiv-2210-16285.creator: Muhammad Irfan Yousuf, Izza Anwer, Tanzeela Shakir, Minahil Siddiqui, Maysoon Shahid
arxiv-2210-16285.description: Abstract This paper describes a multi-feature dataset for training machine learning classifiers for detecting malicious Windows Portable Executable (PE) files. The dataset includes four feature sets from 18,551 binary samples belonging to five malware families including Spyware, Ransomware, Downloader, Backdoor and Generic Malware.

arxiv-2411-09813.title: Can Features for Phishing URL Detection Be Trusted Across Diverse Datasets? A Case Study with Explainable AI
arxiv-2411-09813.creator: Maraz Mia, Darius Derakhshan, Mir Mehedi A. Pritom
arxiv-2411-09813.description: Abstract . Phishing has been a prevalent cyber threat that manipulates users into revealing sensitive private information through deceptive tactics, designed to masquerade as trustworthy entities. Over the years, proactively detection of phishing URLs (or websites) has been established as an widely-accepted defense approach.

arxiv-2501-07084.title: The exact convex roof for GHZ-W mixtures for three qubits and beyond
arxiv-2501-07084.creator: Andreas Osterloh
arxiv-2501-07084.description: Abstract I present an exact solution for the convex roof of the square root threetangle for all states within the Bloch sphere. The working hypothesis is that optimal decompositions contain as many states from the zero-polytope as possible which can be called zero-state locking.

arxiv-2505-02894.title: Upper bound on T c T_{c} in a strongly coupled electron-boson superconductor
arxiv-2505-02894.creator: Nikolay V. Gnezdilov, Rufus Boyack
arxiv-2505-02894.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nikolay V. Gnezdilov, Rufus Boyack. Migdal-Eliashberg theory (METh) of boson-mediated superconductivity contains a λ \sqrt{\lambda} divergence in the critical temperature T c T_{c} at strong electron-boson coupling λ \lambda . In conventional METh, the strong-coupling regime can be accessed only in the limit that λ E = λ ​ ω D / ε F ≪ 1 \lambda_{E}=\lambda\,\omega_{D}/\varepsilon_{F}\ll 1 , where ω D \omega_{D} is the Debye frequency and ε F \varepsilon_{F} is the Fermi energy.

arxiv-2505-09183.title: Ordinary and spectral extremal problems on vertex disjoint copies of even fans
arxiv-2505-09183.creator: Yiting Cai, Bo Zhou
arxiv-2505-09183.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yiting Cai, Bo Zhou. Let ex ⁡ ( n , F ) \mathrm{ex}(n,F) and spex ⁡ ( n , F ) \mathrm{spex}(n,F) be the maximum size and spectral radius among all F F -free graphs with fixed order n n , respectively.

arxiv-2506-13770.title: CDST: Color Disentangled Style Transfer for Universal Style Reference Customization
arxiv-2506-13770.creator: Shiwen Zhang, Zhuowei Chen, Lang Chen, Yanze Wu
arxiv-2506-13770.description: Abstract We introduce Color Disentangled Style Transfer (CDST), a novel and efficient two-stream style transfer training paradigm which completely isolates color from style and forces the style stream to be color-blinded. With one same model, CDST unlocks universal style transfer capabilities in a tuning-free manner during inference.

arxiv-2511-11013.title: Chiral active gyrator: Memory induced direction reversal of rotational motion
arxiv-2511-11013.creator: S Deion, F Adersh, M Sahoo
arxiv-2511-11013.description: Abstract We theoretically explore the dynamics of a chiral active Ornstein–Uhlenbeck particle confined in a two-dimensional anisotropic harmonic trap. The particle is driven by chirality and is coupled to two orthogonal heat baths, potentially at two different temperatures. Using both analytical approach and numerical simulation, we explore the rotational dynamics of the particle in both viscous and viscoelastic environments.

arxiv-2602-08131.title: Fields of The World: A Field Guide for Extracting Agricultural Field Boundaries
arxiv-2602-08131.creator: Isaac Corley, Hannah Kerner, Caleb Robinson, Jennifer Marcus
arxiv-2602-08131.description: Abstract Field boundary maps are a building block for agricultural data products and support crop monitoring, yield estimation, and disease estimation. This tutorial presents the Fields of The World (FTW) ecosystem: a benchmark of 1.6M field polygons across 24 countries, pre-trained segmentation models, and command-line inference tools.

plos-pone-0001507.creator: Barbara Di Ventura, Charlotta Funaya, Claude Antony et al.
plos-pone-0001507.description: PLOS ONE research article. p53 mediates cell cycle arrest or apoptosis in response to DNA damage. Its activity is subject to a tight regulation involving a multitude of post-translational modifications. pmc-10552531.title: Response assessment of post-treatment head and neck cancers to determine further management using NI-RADS (Neck Imaging Reporting and Data System): a subgroup analysis of a randomized controlled trial
pmc-10552531.creator: Abhishek Mahajan, Himangi Unde, Nilesh P. Sable, Shreya Shukla, Richa Vaish, Vijay Patil, Ujjwal Agarwal, Archi Agrawal, Vanita Noronha, Amit Joshi, Akhil Kapoor, Nandini Menon, Jai Prakash Agarwal, Sarbani Ghosh Laskar, Anil Keith Dcruz, Pankaj Chaturvedi, Prathamesh Pai, Swapnil Ulhas Rane, Munita
pmc-10552531.description: ObjectiveInterpreting complex post-treatment changes in head and neck cancer (HNC) is challenging with further added perplexity due to variable interobserver interpretation and hence evolved the NI-RADS lexicon. We evaluated the accuracy of NI-RADS in predicting disease status on 1st post-treatment follow-up CECT in a homogenous cohort of those who received only chemoradiation.

pmc-10561638.title: A retrospective study: analysis of the relationship between lactate dehydrogenase and castration-resistant prostate cancer based on restricted cubic spline model
pmc-10561638.creator: Ruiying Qiu, Ke Bu, Hengqing An, Ning Tao, Yuriy Orlov
pmc-10561638.description: BackgroundDifferent prostate cancer patients take different amounts of time to progress to castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC), and this difference in time determines the patient’s ultimate survival time. If the time to progression to CRPC can be estimated for each patient, the treatment can be better individualized.

pmc-10962565.title: Variational log‐Gaussian point‐process methods for grid cells
pmc-10962565.creator: Michael Everett Rule, Prannoy Chaudhuri‐Vayalambrone, Marino Krstulovic, Marius Bauza, Julija Krupic, Timothy O'Leary
pmc-10962565.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We present practical solutions to applying Gaussian‐process (GP) methods to calculate spatial statistics for grid cells in large environments. GPs are a data efficient approach to inferring neural tuning as a function of time, space, and other variables. We discuss how to design appropriate kernels for grid cells, and show that a variational Bayesian approach to log‐Gaussian Poisson models can be calculated quickly.

pmc-11470678.title: Fluctuation trend of inflammatory indexes related to gestational diabetes mellitus from second trimester to third trimester of pregnancy
pmc-11470678.creator: Mingming Xu, Linlin Tang, Yaping Wang
pmc-11470678.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to assess the prognostic and diagnostic value of inflammatory indexes related to gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from the second trimester to the third trimester of pregnancy.Materials and methodsIn this study, we randomly selected 65 pregnant women diagnosed with GDM at our hospital from December 2022 to June 2023 to form the GDM group (n = 65).

pmc-11544058.title: Downregulation of circSTX6 suppresses tumor progression while facilitating radiosensitivity in cervical squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11544058.creator: Xiaokang Hu, Fan Xing, Yue Yin, Ning Zhao, Lina Xing, Guanglu Dong, Wei Xu
pmc-11544058.description: Backgroundcervical squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC) is the second gynecological tumors that seriously threaten women's life quality. Circular RNA (circRNA) is related with cervical cancer carcinogenesis and radiosensitivity.AimTo investigate the performance of hsa_circ_0007905 (circSTX6) on regulating cellular activities and radiosensitivity in CSCC.MethodsThe relative expression of circSTX6 in different tissue samples was detected by RT-qPCR.

pmc-11590451.title: Migrants and refugees’ health financing in Morocco: How much is the hidden contribution of the government through free services?
pmc-11590451.creator: El Houcine Akhnif, Awad Mataria, Abdelouahab Belmadani, Maryam Bigdeli
pmc-11590451.description: BackgroundThe health of migrants and refugees is a key component in achieving Universal Health Coverage (UHC). This paper aims to assess the scale of financing mobilized by the Moroccan government for migrants and refugees health, and addressing health issues related to these populations within the ongoing health reforms.

pmc-12532997.title: Angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor treatment in people with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and heart failure
pmc-12532997.creator: Wan-Hsuan Hsu, Bo-Wen Shiau, Jheng-Yan Wu, Min-Hsiang Chuang, Ya-Wen Tsai, Po-Yu Huang, Khai-Chi Hu, Wei Hsu, Ting-Hui Liu, Kuang-Ming Liao, Chih-Cheng Lai
pmc-12532997.description: BackgroundWhile renin-angiotensin system inhibitors (RASi) have shown benefits for people with both heart failure (HF) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), limited data exists on the use of angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitors (ARNIs) in this population. This study compares the effectiveness of RASi and ARNIs in people with coexisting COPD and HF.

pmc-12742282.title: Clathrins Are Involved in the Endocytosis of Host Cytosol in the Malaria Parasite
pmc-12742282.creator: Jun Miao, Amuza Byaruhanga Lucky, Gang Ning, Xian Xia, Xiaoying Liang, Faiza Siddiqui, Hui Min, Chengqi Wang, Xiaolian Li, Z Hong Zhou, Liwang Cui
pmc-12742282.description: In eukaryotic cells, clathrins interact with the adaptor protein (AP) complex‐2 (AP‐2) to facilitate endocytosis and AP‐1 to mediate secretion and trafficking between the endosome and Golgi. In Plasmodium falciparum, recent studies revealed that the Kelch domain‐containing protein 13 and AP‐2 participate in hemoglobin uptake via cytostomes.

pmc-13141709.title: L-cysteine enhances heat-stress adaptation in meat-type chickens through modulation of cysteine-metabolic and nutrient transporter genes
pmc-13141709.creator: Bikash Aryal, Oluwatomide W Ariyo, Josephine Kwakye, Selorm Sovi, Ahmed FA Ghareeb, Evan Hartono, Marie C Milfort, Alberta L Fuller, Romdhane Rekaya, Samuel E Aggrey
pmc-13141709.description: Heat stress (HS) is a major challenge in poultry production due to its negative effects on growth, metabolism, and redox balance. Excessive reactive oxygen species generated during HS contribute to oxidative damage, emphasizing the need for nutritional strategies that enhance antioxidant capacity.

pmc-13312655.title: Risk score for esophageal and gastric cancer in the over 50-year-old population based on self-reported information –the RISC-GAP project
pmc-13312655.creator: Timo Schmitz, Julia Reizner, Sha Sha, Ben Schöttker, Hermann Brenner, David Roser, Helmut Messmann, Christa Meisinger, Jakob Linseisen

pmc-13400424.title: Whole genome dataset of bacterial strains isolated from urine analysed by Oxford Nanopore sequencing technologies in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso
pmc-13400424.creator: Pamane Djagbaré, Ezechiel Bionimian Tibiri, Wendyam Marie Christelle Nadembèga, Pakyendou Estel Name, Lassina Traoré, Emmanuel Sampo, Moussa Ouédraogo, Fidèle Tiendrebéogo, Jacques Simporé
pmc-13400424.description: A collection of 21 bacterial isolates recovered from urine specimens collected between September 2018 and February 2019 at Saint-Camille and SCHIPHRA hospitals in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, is presented. Isolates were identified using the API 20E system and tested for antibiotic susceptibility according to CASFM 2018 guidelines. Genomic DNA was extracted, barcoded with the SQK-RBK114.

pmc-13445852.title: Coronary artery bypass grafting patients’ preferences and willingness to pay for remote cardiac rehabilitation: discrete choice experiment study
pmc-13445852.creator: Dongyu Song, Shanshan Lyu, Haizhou Zhang, Huihui Wang, Guixia Li, Shuangyan Jiang, Xianfeng Liu, Jing Zheng
pmc-13445852.description: BackgroundCardiac rehabilitation (CR) uptake among coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) patients in China is extremely low. Remote cardiac rehabilitation (RCR) offers a promising alternative, but its design must be informed by patient’s preferences to ensure adoption. This study aimed to quantify CABG patients’ preferences and willingness-to-pay (WTP) for key RCR attributes to inform patient-centered service design.
